title: LOOP_V0 active_iteration
description: Live state file at run_state/active_iteration.json. Written by Nara on every step; deleted on completion. The UI polls this to render the live panel.

current_step.description: The tool currently in flight, or 'nara_thinking' between calls, or 'starting' at iteration open.

latest_narration.description: Most-recent narration sentence Nara emitted before the current step.

orchestrator_backend.description: Backend (registry name, e.g. 'vllm-gemma', 'anthropic') that drives the Nara orchestrator brain for this iteration. Null for iterations written before the multi-backend substrate landed.

orchestrator_model.description: Served-model-name the orchestrator backend is using (e.g. 'gemma-4-26b-a4b'). Pairs with orchestrator_backend; null on legacy iterations.

steps.description: Planned-chain status board (2026-06-10): the 5-step LOOP_V0 chain plus the meta_review pre-step, with dynamic sub-loop steps (redteam, ml_intern) inserted when they fire. Absent on pre-2026-06-10 iterations — the UI falls back to its static strip.

backend.description: Backend that powered this tool's LLM calls (registry name). Inherits from orchestrator_backend unless the worker reported a backend_used override in its tool_result. Null for tools that don't make LLM calls (e.g. retrieve_literature, journal_writer).

model.description: Served-model-name the tool used. Pairs with backend.

subagent_backend.description: When a tool dispatched a SubAgent (today: critic_loop_v0), the backend that powered the sub-agent. May differ from the tool's own backend once selective sub-agent backend overrides land (Co-Scientist insight; D-035).

subagent_model.description: Served-model-name the sub-agent used. Pairs with subagent_backend.
